claims.citation: New York Herald, 25 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
[illegible] (Brem), Friedrichs[?], Rotterdam, July 13[?], with [cut]
mdse and passengers, to Funch, Meincke & Wendt. 8th inst,
lat 42 14, lon 39 59, spoke whaling bark Brewster, of and
from New Bedford, 3 months out, with 51 bbls sperm oil;
9th, lat 43 56, lon 44 29, saw ship Webster, hence for Liver-
pool; 16th, lat 42 50, lon 61 04, saw bark Ada J York, from
New Orleans for Liverpool, and bark Mary Lord (Br), hence
for do.
